source_doc: FDA Approval Summary: Nadofaragene firadenovec-vncg for BCG-unresponsive NMIBC (PMC11961324)
notes: FDA approval 16 Dec 2022. Label scope row, no number. The FDA approval summary gives no national incidence figures.

indication_label: all bladder cancer (base population, not label-restricted)
unit: new bladder cancer diagnoses per year
verbatim: The National Cancer Institute estimates that more than 82,000 patients will be diagnosed with bladder cancer in 2023, of which an estimated 70% will be diagnosed with non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC), and approximately 10% of that patient population will have carcinoma in situ (CIS). Additionally, more than 50% of patients who receive initial treatment with BCG will experience disease recurrence and progression within one year, with many developing BCG-unresponsive disease.
source_doc: Ferring Pharmaceuticals USA press release, NCCN guideline update for ADSTILADRIN in BCG-unresponsive NMIBC (search snippet; page returned HTTP 403)
notes: Population base = all US bladder cancer; NCI 2023 estimate as quoted by Ferring. Exact release date not captured (BusinessWire id 20230912802578 suggests 12 Sep 2023). Company statement of the framing, not an eligible count.

indication_label: NMIBC with CIS at diagnosis (upper bound for label-eligible pool; BCG-unresponsive subset not applied)
unit: patients per year
source_doc: Derived from Ferring/NCI framing (row above)
notes: Arithmetic: 82,000 bladder cancer diagnoses x 70% NMIBC x 10% with CIS = 5,740 NMIBC-with-CIS diagnoses per year. Overstates the label pool because only BCG-treated patients who become BCG-unresponsive qualify; understates slightly because CIS can emerge at recurrence. Treat as ceiling.

indication_label: BCG-unresponsive NMIBC with CIS (crude bracket)
unit: patients per year
source_doc: Derived from Ferring/NCI framing and Ferring statement that more than 50% recur within one year after BCG
notes: Weak bracket. Recurrence after BCG is not the same as BCG-unresponsive per FDA definition; the true label-eligible incident pool is probably below the low end. No published US eligible count found (Europe PMC query for BCG-unresponsive CIS per-year estimates returned no quantified abstract). Report as range only.

indication_label: BCG response and recurrence rates (rate inputs)

source_doc: FDA Approval Summary: Nadofaragene firadenovec-vncg (PMC11961324)
notes: Rate inputs only; population base = BCG-treated high-risk NMIBC. Use with the NMIBC-with-CIS count above.
